title_quote: Lucy, come look at this screen.
youtube_title: 【睡前英文聽力】📵 實用少滑手機必備常用英文短句 ｜ 不用背！睡覺聽就會 ｜ 🌱A2 ｜ 💡800句循環聽 ｜ 零基礎也能開口說
youtube_title_en: 800 Everyday English Phrases While You Sleep — Limiting Phone Use
youtube_description: 睡著學英文！這部影片收錄實用的少滑手機情境對話（每兩句成一組：男聲常速 ➡ 女聲慢速 ➡ 男女連貫），從兩人一起看本週螢幕時間報告、替每個 App 給自己定上限、果斷關掉一個短影音 App、設夜間模式與灰階畫面、晚飯把手機放進碗裡、九點開勿擾模式與真的鬧鐘、週末開飛航模式爬山，到和朋友相約不帶手機散步，不用背，睡前聽就會。重複播放，讓英文自然進入你的大腦。👍 想學更多生活場景，請留言告訴我！別忘了訂閱+按讚。 #英文聽力 #睡前英文 #LearnEnglish
youtube_description_en: Learn English while you sleep! This video features practical Limiting Phone Use phrase pairs (each pair: male normal speed → female slow speed → combined dialogue) — two roommates read the weekly screen-time report out loud, set a daily cap for every app, delete the short-video app for good, dim the screen with night mode and a gray screen, drop both phones into a bowl at dinner, switch on do-not-disturb at nine with one real alarm clock, walk a weekend trail on airplane mode, and meet friends for a no-phone riverside walk. No memorization needed—just listen before bed and absorb naturally. If you want more real-life scenarios, leave a comment! Subscribe and like!

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Lucy, come look at this screen.
dialogue.zh: 露西，快來看這個螢幕。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Is that the weekly report?
dialogue.zh: 那是每週報告嗎？

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Yes, it lists every single app.
dialogue.zh: 對，每個 App 都列出來了。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Start with your own total.
dialogue.zh: 先看你自己的總量。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Mine says twenty-nine hours.
dialogue.zh: 我的是廿九小時。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: That is four hours a day.
dialogue.zh: 那就是一天四小時。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Four and twelve minutes, exactly.
dialogue.zh: 四小時十二分，一點不錯。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Did you expect a smaller number?
dialogue.zh: 你本來以為會更少？

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: I thought maybe two hours.
dialogue.zh: 我以為大概兩小時。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: The screen never lies to us.
dialogue.zh: 螢幕從不騙我們。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Look here, I unlock it often.
dialogue.zh: 你看這裡，我常解鎖。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: How many times on Monday?
dialogue.zh: 星期一幾次？

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Sixty-one, and that is wild.
dialogue.zh: 六十一個，太誇張了。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Sixty-one looks like habit.
dialogue.zh: 六十一個就是習慣。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: I checked it twice before breakfast.
dialogue.zh: 我吃早飯前就看了兩次。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Twelve minutes on the browser.
dialogue.zh: 瀏覽器十二分鐘。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: What sits at the top?
dialogue.zh: 排第一的是哪個？

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Your video app owns first place.
dialogue.zh: 你的影片 App 排第一。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: That tiny square steals the most time.
dialogue.phonetic: /ðæt ˈtaɪni skwɛr stilz ðə moʊst taɪm./
dialogue.zh: 那個小方塊吃掉最多時間。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Short videos? Really?
dialogue.zh: 短影片？真的假的？

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: You watch them on the bus too.
dialogue.phonetic: /ju wɑtʃ ðɛm ɑn ðə bʌs tu./
dialogue.zh: 你在公車上也會看呀。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Only twenty minutes, then I walk home.
dialogue.phonetic: /ˈoʊnli ˈtwɛnti ˈmɪnɪts, ðɛn aɪ wɔk hoʊm./
dialogue.zh: 只有二十分鐘，然後我走路回家。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Twenty here, then twenty there.
dialogue.zh: 這裡二十分鐘，那裡二十分鐘。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Twenty-nine hours is not small.
dialogue.zh: 廿九小時一點都不小。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Nine minutes on the weather app.
dialogue.zh: 天氣 App 九分鐘。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Do we need rain twice a day?
dialogue.phonetic: /du wi nid reɪn twaɪs ə deɪ?/
dialogue.zh: 一天要問兩次會不會下雨？

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: I open it just for the time.
dialogue.phonetic: /aɪ ˈoʊpən ɪt dʒʌst fɔr ðə taɪm./
dialogue.zh: 我打開它只是為了看時間。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Use the clock on the stove.
dialogue.zh: 用爐子上那個時鐘就好。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Fair point, I never said no.
dialogue.zh: 你說得對，我沒反駁。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Now look at the late hours.
dialogue.zh: 再看看深夜那幾段。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: One a.m., and two a.m.
dialogue.phonetic: /wʌn eɪ ˈɛm, ænd tu eɪ ˈɛm./
dialogue.zh: 一點，還有兩點。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Those two hours hurt the most.
dialogue.zh: 那兩小時最傷人。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: I only checked one message.
dialogue.zh: 我只看了一則訊息。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: One message became fifty minutes.
dialogue.zh: 一則訊息變成五十分鐘。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Where did you see that?
dialogue.zh: 你是在哪裡看到的？

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: The bar says fifty-two minutes.
dialogue.zh: 長條圖寫的是五十二分鐘。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Okay, you caught me there.
dialogue.zh: 好吧，被你抓到。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: I caught nobody, the report did.
dialogue.zh: 我沒抓你，是報告抓的。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: It also shows my worst day.
dialogue.zh: 它還顯示我最糟的那天。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Which day was that?
dialogue.zh: 哪天？

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Saturday, seven hours and ten.
dialogue.zh: 星期六，七小時十分。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: We cleaned the flat that day.
dialogue.zh: 那天我們還在整理房子。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: I rested between the boxes.
dialogue.zh: 我在箱子中間休息。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Resting is fine, scrolling ate it.
dialogue.zh: 休息沒事，是滑手機吃掉了。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Scrolling ate it, yes.
dialogue.zh: 是滑手機吃掉的，沒錯。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Where did the other hours go?
dialogue.zh: 其他幾小時去哪了？

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Mostly after dinner, on the couch.
dialogue.zh: 多半在晚飯後，躺沙發上。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: The couch is a trap for you.
dialogue.phonetic: /ðə kaʊtʃ ɪz æ træp fɔːr ju./
dialogue.zh: 沙發對你就是個陷阱。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: A soft trap, I will admit.
dialogue.zh: 柔軟的陷阱，我承認。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Write the number on that note.
dialogue.zh: 把數字寫在那張便條上。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Four twelve, in big letters.
dialogue.zh: 四一二，寫大一點。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Big letters help at eleven p.m.
dialogue.phonetic: /bɪɡ ˈlɛtərz hɛlp æt ɪˈlɛvən pi ˈɛm./
dialogue.zh: 十一點時大字才有用。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Did you see my long blocks?
dialogue.zh: 你看見我那幾大段了嗎？

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Two blocks longer than an hour.
dialogue.zh: 有兩段超過一小時。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: One was a live show.
dialogue.zh: 其中一個是直播節目。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: And the other was nothing.
dialogue.zh: 另一個什麼也沒有。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Nothing at all, just swiping.
dialogue.zh: 什麼都沒有，就一直滑。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: An hour gone, with nothing to show.
dialogue.phonetic: /æn ˈaʊər ɡɔn, wɪθ ˈnʌθɪŋ tə ʃoʊ./
dialogue.zh: 一小時沒了，卻什麼都沒留下。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: And what does yours say, then?
dialogue.zh: 那你的報告寫著多少？

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: One hour, seventeen, on videos.
dialogue.zh: 影片上一小時十七分。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: You also have a graph?
dialogue.zh: 你也有曲線圖？

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Mine climbs every Sunday night.
dialogue.zh: 我的每個週日晚上往上爬。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Mine looks like a city now.
dialogue.zh: 我的現在像座城市。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: A tired city, by the shape.
dialogue.zh: 從形狀看，是座很累的城市。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Should we feel bad about this?
dialogue.zh: 我們該難過嗎？

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Not bad, just honest about it.
dialogue.zh: 不用難過，誠實面對就好。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: I feel a little bad.
dialogue.zh: 我有一點難過。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Good, that means you care.
dialogue.zh: 很好，代表你還在意。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Two hours of my night, gone.
dialogue.zh: 我夜裡的兩個小時，沒了。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: You could have slept those hours.
dialogue.zh: 那兩小時你本可以睡。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Or made rice and eggs.
dialogue.zh: 或是煮飯炒蛋。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Or called your mother once.
dialogue.zh: 或是打給你媽一次。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Do not start lecturing me.
dialogue.zh: 先別開始教訓我。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: I am only reading the report.
dialogue.zh: 我只是在唸報告內容。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Reading it out loud stings.
dialogue.zh: 唸出來真的很刺。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Then let the numbers do the work.
dialogue.phonetic: /ðɛn lɛt ðə ˈnʌmbərz du ðə wɜːrk./
dialogue.zh: 那就讓數字去說話。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Sam says he uses nine.
dialogue.zh: 山姆說他用九小時。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Sam sleeps with that thing nightly.
dialogue.zh: 山姆每天晚上一邊滑一邊睡。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Should we tell him our numbers?
dialogue.zh: 要跟他說我們的數字嗎？

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Send the screenshot, but say nothing.
dialogue.zh: 傳截圖就好，別多說。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: He will laugh at mine.
dialogue.zh: 他會笑我的。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: He might copy mine instead.
dialogue.zh: 他也許反而會學我。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Copy is fine, I want help.
dialogue.zh: 學我就好，我需要幫忙。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: First we need a real cap.
dialogue.zh: 我們先要一個真正的上限。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: A cap today, or next week?
dialogue.zh: 今天就設，還是下週？

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Tonight, while the sting still works.
dialogue.zh: 今晚，趁還在痛。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: The report lands every Sunday.
dialogue.zh: 報告每個星期日都會來。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: So Sunday is our counting night.
dialogue.zh: 所以週日是我們的盤點夜。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: I will set a note at eight.
dialogue.phonetic: /aɪ wɪl sɛt ə noʊt æt eɪt./
dialogue.zh: 我八點設一個提醒。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Make it eight, and put the phone down.
dialogue.phonetic: /meɪk ɪt eɪt, ænd pʊt ðə foʊn daʊn./
dialogue.zh: 設八點，然後把手機放下。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: This paper list feels old.
dialogue.zh: 這張紙上的清單感覺很老派。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Old paper works better for you.
dialogue.zh: 老派的紙更適合你。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Fine, I will write the cap here.
dialogue.phonetic: /faɪn, aɪ wɪl raɪt ðə kæp hɪər./
dialogue.zh: 好，我把上限寫在這。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Start with the apps on page one.
dialogue.phonetic: /stɑrt wɪt ði æps ɑn peɪdʒ wʌn./
dialogue.zh: 從第一頁那些 App 開始。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Page one is all social stuff.
dialogue.zh: 第一頁全都是社群那些。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Then page one is our first target.
dialogue.phonetic: /ðɛn peɪdʒ wʌn ɪz ˈaʊər fɜːrst ˈtɑrɡɪt./
dialogue.zh: 那第一頁就是我們的第一個目標。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: One target, then we eat dessert.
dialogue.zh: 達標了再吃甜點。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Deal, but dessert only after the cap.
dialogue.phonetic: /dil, bʌt dɪˈzɜːrt ˈoʊnli ˈæftər ðə kæp./
dialogue.zh: 成交，但要先設上限再吃。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Write tomorrow's first step too.
dialogue.zh: 也把明天的第一步寫下來。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Seven a.m., tea, and the list.
dialogue.phonetic: /ˈsɛvən eɪ ˈɛm, tiː, ænd ðə lɪst./
dialogue.zh: 早上七點、茶，還有那張清單。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Open the settings, then the graph.
dialogue.zh: 打開設定，再看曲線圖。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: I see a small limit button.
dialogue.zh: 我看到一個小小的上限按鈕。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Tap it for the social app.
dialogue.zh: 幫那個社群 App 點下去。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: It asks how long each day.
dialogue.zh: 它問每天要用多久。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: You use three hours, set forty.
dialogue.zh: 你用三小時，先設四十分。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Is forty even a real choice?
dialogue.zh: 四十分算是認真的嗎？

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Two hours feels closer to honest.
dialogue.zh: 兩小時比較誠實。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Two is still a lot for us.
dialogue.phonetic: /tuː ɪz stɪl ə lɑt fɔːr ʌs./
dialogue.zh: 兩小時對我們還是太多。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Then try forty-five for week one.
dialogue.phonetic: /ðɛn traɪ ˈfɔːrti faɪv fɔːr wik wʌn./
dialogue.zh: 那第一週先試四十五。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Forty-five feels fair enough.
dialogue.zh: 四十五我覺得夠公平。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Now it wants a pass code.
dialogue.zh: 現在它要一組密碼。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Type one I will never guess.
dialogue.zh: 輸入一組我猜不到的。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Your birthday is too easy.
dialogue.zh: 你的生日太好猜。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Then you hold my little code.
dialogue.zh: 那你幫我收著密碼。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: I will keep it on paper.
dialogue.zh: 我會寫在紙上收好。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Paper is hard to hack.
dialogue.zh: 紙本比較難被破解。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: What happens when the time ends?
dialogue.zh: 時間到了會怎樣？

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: The screen turns gray and waits.
dialogue.zh: 螢幕變灰，然後等。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: It also offers fifteen more.
dialogue.zh: 它也會再多給十五分鐘。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: We agree not to tap that.
dialogue.zh: 我們說好不點那個。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Tapping once is just cheating.
dialogue.zh: 多點一下就是作弊。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Quiet cheating is the easy kind.
dialogue.zh: 安靜地作弊，那種最容易。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: So I will tell you each time.
dialogue.phonetic: /soʊ aɪ wɪl tɛl ju itʃ taɪm./
dialogue.zh: 所以每次我都會告訴你。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Deal, I will ask if you tapped.
dialogue.phonetic: /dil, aɪ wɪl æsk ɪf ju tæpt./
dialogue.zh: 成交，我會問你有沒有多點一下。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Games need a cap tonight too.
dialogue.zh: 遊戲今晚也要設上限。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Twenty minutes there is plenty.
dialogue.zh: 那邊二十分鐘就夠了。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: The browser gets twenty as well.
dialogue.zh: 瀏覽器也給二十分鐘。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Music can stay wide open.
dialogue.zh: 音樂可以完全不設限。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Music never costs me hours.
dialogue.zh: 音樂不會花我幾小時。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: You cook better with it on, though.
dialogue.phonetic: /ju kʊk ˈbɛtər wɪð ɪt ɑn, ðoʊ./
dialogue.zh: 你開著音樂煮飯更好吃，真的。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Maps must stay free, I drive.
dialogue.zh: 地圖要留著，我開車。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Email too, your boss checks late.
dialogue.zh: 郵件也是，你老闆很晚還看。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Podcasts count as screen time?
dialogue.zh: 播客也算螢幕時間嗎？

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Only if you watch the page.
dialogue.zh: 只有你在盯頁面時才算。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: I play them while I cook.
dialogue.zh: 我煮飯時播放。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Then prop the phone on the jar.
dialogue.phonetic: /ðɛn prɑp ðə foʊn ɑn ðə dʒɑːr./
dialogue.zh: 那就把手機靠在罐子上。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Good, the jar keeps my hands free.
dialogue.phonetic: /ɡʊd, ðə dʒɑːr kips maɪ hændz friː./
dialogue.zh: 好，罐子讓我的手空著。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: A jar costs nothing, well done.
dialogue.zh: 罐子不用錢，聰明。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: What about the video app?
dialogue.zh: 那個影片 App 呢？

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: It sits inside the forty-five.
dialogue.zh: 它算在那四十五分鐘裡面。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: So forty-five covers three apps.
dialogue.zh: 所以四十五分鐘包三個 App。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Yes, pick the worst three now.
dialogue.zh: 對，現在挑最糟的三個。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Videos, photos, and the chat.
dialogue.zh: 影片、照片，還有聊天。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: The chat is work, leave it.
dialogue.zh: 那個聊天群是工作，留著。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Your chat is only friends.
dialogue.zh: 你那一個只有朋友。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Friends also eat my whole evening.
dialogue.zh: 朋友也會吃光我一整晚。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Then cap the friends at twenty.
dialogue.zh: 那就把朋友設成二十。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Done, my thumbs feel shaky now.
dialogue.zh: 設好了，我的拇指還有點抖。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Twenty for you, Lucy, is hard.
dialogue.zh: 露西，二十對你很難。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: I know, that is why I set it.
dialogue.phonetic: /aɪ noʊ, ðæt ɪz waɪ aɪ sɛt ɪt./
dialogue.zh: 我知道，所以才要設。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Mine is three hours, watch me.
dialogue.zh: 我是三小時，你瞧著。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: You will make it, I think.
dialogue.zh: 你做得到，我相信。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Set yours first, then I believe you.
dialogue.phonetic: /sɛt jʊərz fɜːrst, ðɛn aɪ bɪˈliv ju./
dialogue.zh: 你先設你的，我才信。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Fine, my news app gets thirty.
dialogue.zh: 好啦，我的新聞 App 給三十分。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Thirty news minutes sounds calm.
dialogue.zh: 三十分新聞聽起來平靜。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: News is worse than videos for me.
dialogue.phonetic: /nuz ɪz wɜːrs ðæn ˈvɪdioʊz fɔːr mi./
dialogue.zh: 新聞對我比影片更糟。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Do the caps reset each day?
dialogue.zh: 上限每天會重置嗎？

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: At midnight, clean and quiet.
dialogue.zh: 半夜十二點，安靜地重來。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Midnight reset is kind of sweet.
dialogue.zh: 半夜重置還蠻貼心的。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Sweet on paper, mean at nine.
dialogue.zh: 紙上甜蜜，九點就狠了。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: What if the bell rings mid-call?
dialogue.phonetic: /wʌt ɪf ðə bɛl rɪŋz mɪd kɔl?/
dialogue.zh: 要是在通話中間響了？

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Calls skip the limit, we are safe.
dialogue.phonetic: /kɔlz skɪp ðə ˈlɪmɪt, wi ɑr seɪf./
dialogue.zh: 通話不算上限，我們安全。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Good, my sister calls on Fridays.
dialogue.zh: 好，我姊週五會打來。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Then Friday nights are already free.
dialogue.zh: 那週五晚上本來就不受限。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Let us test this for one night.
dialogue.phonetic: /lɛt ʌs tɛst ðɪs fɔːr wʌn naɪt./
dialogue.zh: 我們先試一個晚上。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Tonight, then we look tomorrow.
dialogue.zh: 今晚試，明天再看。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: I feel silly for being nervous.
dialogue.zh: 我緊張得很丟臉。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Sixty-one unlocks would worry anyone.
dialogue.zh: 六十一個解鎖誰都會心慌。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Who holds the code, me or you?
dialogue.phonetic: /hu hoʊldz ðə koʊd, mi ɔːr ju?/
dialogue.zh: 密碼誰拿，你還是我？

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: You use the app, so I hold it.
dialogue.phonetic: /ju juz ðə æp, soʊ aɪ hoʊld ɪt./
dialogue.zh: 你用 App，所以我拿。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: That feels like a parent move.
dialogue.zh: 那感覺像在管小孩。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: The parent trick works, most times.
dialogue.zh: 爸媽那一招，大部分時候有用。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Write both caps on the fridge.
dialogue.zh: 把兩個上限寫在冰箱上。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Fridge note, plus the paper list.
dialogue.zh: 冰箱便條，再加紙本清單。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Sam answered, he wants sixty.
dialogue.zh: 山姆回了，他要六十分。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Sixty minutes, from nine hours daily.
dialogue.zh: 六十分，從每天九小時降下來。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Tell him we will check Sunday.
dialogue.zh: 跟他說我們週日會核對。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Sunday needs a photo of numbers.
dialogue.zh: 週日要拍一張數字的照片。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Do I cut games or videos first?
dialogue.phonetic: /du aɪ kʌt ɡeɪmz ɔːr ˈvɪdioʊz fɜːrst?/
dialogue.zh: 我先砍遊戲還是影片？

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Videos run longer, so start there.
dialogue.zh: 影片更長，先從那裡下手。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: My mom uses five, by the way.
dialogue.phonetic: /maɪ mɑm ˈjuzɪz faɪv, baɪ ðə weɪ./
dialogue.zh: 對了，我媽用五小時。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Five hours of what, exactly?
dialogue.zh: 五小時都在看什麼？

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Plants, recipes, loud videos.
dialogue.zh: 植物、食譜、很大聲的影片。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Send her a cap, not a speech.
dialogue.phonetic: /sɛnd hɜːr ə kæp, nɑt ə spiːtʃ./
dialogue.zh: 傳個上限給她，別說教。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: She will say no, you know.
dialogue.zh: 她會說不要，你知道的。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: I will ask her kindly tonight.
dialogue.zh: 我今晚好好問她。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Kindly is not your strong suit.
dialogue.zh: 好好說話不是你的長項。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Then you ask her, I will cook.
dialogue.phonetic: /ðɛn ju æsk hɜːr, aɪ wɪl kʊk./
dialogue.zh: 那你去問，我來煮飯。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Deal, caps tonight, food after.
dialogue.zh: 成交，先設上限再吃飯。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Wait, dinner is in ten minutes.
dialogue.zh: 等等，十分鐘後就吃飯了。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Perfect, we set the cap hungry.
dialogue.zh: 正好，餓著設上限。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Hungry people obey rules better.
dialogue.zh: 餓的人更守規矩。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: One more thing before the stove.
dialogue.zh: 進廚房前還有一件事。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Name it, I am still holding this phone.
dialogue.phonetic: /neɪm ɪt, aɪ æm stɪl ˈhoʊldɪŋ ðɪs foʊn./
dialogue.zh: 說吧，我手上還拿著手機。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: No phone before the first coffee.
dialogue.zh: 第一杯咖啡前不碰手機。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: That one is brutal, I agree.
dialogue.zh: 這條很兇，但我答應。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Brutal rules suit big numbers.
dialogue.zh: 兇規則對付大數字。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Put it on the fridge as well.
dialogue.phonetic: /pʊt ɪt ɑn ðə frɪdʒ æz wɛl./
dialogue.zh: 也寫到冰箱上。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: So tomorrow we count again.
dialogue.zh: 明天我們再算一次。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Count, and do not call yourself stupid.
dialogue.phonetic: /kaʊnt, ænd du nɑt kɔl jʊrˈsɛlf ˈstupɪd./
dialogue.zh: 要算，但別罵自己笨。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: We should close one app tonight.
dialogue.zh: 今晚該關掉一個 App。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: One is enough, choose the worst.
dialogue.zh: 一個就夠，挑最糟的那個。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: The video one, I hate it.
dialogue.zh: 那個影片的，我討厭它。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: You hate it and open it daily.
dialogue.phonetic: /ju heɪt ɪt ænd ˈoʊpən ɪt ˈdeɪli./
dialogue.zh: 你討厭它卻天天開。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: It feeds me at two a.m.
dialogue.phonetic: /ɪt fidz mi æt tu eɪ ˈɛm./
dialogue.zh: 它兩點還餵我看。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Then it goes tonight, not next month.
dialogue.phonetic: /ðɛn ɪt ɡoʊz təˈnaɪt, nɑt nɛkst mʌnθ./
dialogue.zh: 那它今晚就刪，不是下個月。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Delete it, or just hide it?
dialogue.zh: 是刪除，還是藏起來？

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Hiding works, my cousin proved that.
dialogue.zh: 藏起來也有效，我表妹證明了。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: She moved hers into a folder.
dialogue.zh: 她把它塞進一個資料夾。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Two taps deeper, and she forgot it.
dialogue.phonetic: /tu tæps ˈdiːpər, ænd ʃi fərˈɡɑt ɪt./
dialogue.zh: 多兩層深，她就忘了。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Deleting feels final, like a door.
dialogue.zh: 刪除很決絕，像關上一個門。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Final is what you need now.
dialogue.zh: 你現在要的就是決絕。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: What happens to my old clips?
dialogue.zh: 我那些舊影片怎麼辦？

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: They wait online, nothing is lost.
dialogue.zh: 它們在雲端，什麼都不會丟。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: And my saved coffee recipes?
dialogue.zh: 我存的咖啡食譜呢？

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Move them to your notes first.
dialogue.zh: 先搬到你的筆記裡面。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Done, nine notes, all saved.
dialogue.zh: 好了，九則筆記都存好了。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Now press remove, I will watch.
dialogue.zh: 現在按移除，我在旁邊看。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: My thumb is stopping, look at it.
dialogue.phonetic: /maɪ θʌm ɪz ˈstɑpɪŋ, lʊk æt ɪt./
dialogue.zh: 我拇指停住了，你看。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: That thumb has a whole habit.
dialogue.zh: 那根拇指有一整套習慣。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Okay, gone, the screen is bright.
dialogue.zh: 好啦，不見了，螢幕好亮。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: How does the empty page feel?
dialogue.zh: 那個空出來的頁面感覺如何？

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: There is a hole where it sat.
dialogue.phonetic: /ðɛr ɪz ə hoʊl wɛr ɪt sæt./
dialogue.zh: 它原本的位置出現一個洞。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Holes get filled, that is good.
dialogue.zh: 洞會被填起來，那是好事。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Filled with what, please tell me.
dialogue.zh: 被什麼填？拜託你說。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: With the book on your table.
dialogue.zh: 用你桌上那本書。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: I never reach that book.
dialogue.zh: 我從不碰那本書。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Now that book gets twenty real nights.
dialogue.phonetic: /naʊ ðæt bʊk ɡɛts ˈtwɛnti ril naɪts./
dialogue.zh: 現在那本書能分到二十個晚上。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Notifications are off too, right?
dialogue.zh: 通知也一起關掉了？

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Off for that app, on for maps.
dialogue.phonetic: /ɔf fɔːr ðæt æp, ɑn fɔːr mæps./
dialogue.zh: 那個關掉，地圖留著。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Photos still buzz, that is fine.
dialogue.zh: 照片那個還會震，沒關係。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Only your mother and two friends.
dialogue.zh: 只有你媽和兩個朋友會震。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Sam laughed when I told him.
dialogue.zh: 我告訴山姆時他笑了。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Laughing people reinstall by Wednesday.
dialogue.zh: 愛笑的人週三就裝回去。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: He reinstalled twice last month.
dialogue.zh: 他上個月裝回去兩次。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Then he needs his own code.
dialogue.zh: 那他就要用自己那組密碼。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: The store asks a code now.
dialogue.zh: 商店現在會問密碼。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: So I keep yours, and you keep mine.
dialogue.phonetic: /soʊ aɪ kip jʊrz, ænd ju kip maɪn./
dialogue.zh: 所以我收你的，你收我的。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: One day without it, how was it?
dialogue.phonetic: /wʌn deɪ wɪˈðaʊt ɪt, haʊ wʌz ɪt?/
dialogue.zh: 沒有它的一天，感覺怎樣？

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Strange, my hand kept searching pockets.
dialogue.zh: 很怪，我的手一直摸口袋。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: The phantom phone, my cousin had it.
dialogue.phonetic: /ðə ˈfæntəm foʊn, maɪ ˈkʌzən hæd ɪt./
dialogue.zh: 幻影手機，我表妹也遇過。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: You feel it buzz, but nothing does.
dialogue.phonetic: /ju fil ɪt bʌz, bʌt ˈnʌθɪŋ dʌz./
dialogue.zh: 你覺得它震，其實沒有。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: I patted my chest nine times.
dialogue.zh: 我拍了自己胸口九次。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Nine times? Your hand is still hunting.
dialogue.phonetic: /naɪn taɪmz? jʊər hænd ɪz stɪl ˈhʌntɪŋ./
dialogue.zh: 九次？你的手還在找手機。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Yesterday I just stood there.
dialogue.zh: 昨天我就站在那裡。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Standing where the icon used to sit?
dialogue.phonetic: /ˈstændɪŋ wɛr ði ˈaɪkɑn juzd tu sɪt?/
dialogue.zh: 站在圖示原本的位置？

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Exactly there, like a ghost.
dialogue.zh: 就在那裡，像看見鬼。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: That ghost fades, it did for me.
dialogue.phonetic: /ðæt ɡoʊst feɪdz, ɪt dɪd fɔr mi./
dialogue.zh: 那個幻覺會淡掉，我那裡就淡了。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: My home screen looks tidy now.
dialogue.zh: 我的主畫面現在很乾淨。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Six icons, that is almost clean.
dialogue.zh: 六個圖示，幾乎算清爽。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: I put my camera in its place.
dialogue.phonetic: /aɪ pʊt maɪ ˈkæmərə ɪn ɪts pleɪs./
dialogue.zh: 我把相機放進那個位子。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Camera stays, you like real light.
dialogue.zh: 相機留著，你喜歡自然光。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Two weeks, then I can reinstall.
dialogue.zh: 兩週後我才可以裝回來。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Two weeks is a fair promise.
dialogue.zh: 兩週是很合理的約定。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: But my job needs that app.
dialogue.zh: 可是我的工作需要那個 App。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Your job never needed it.
dialogue.zh: 你的工作從沒需要過它。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Fun only, yes, that stings again.
dialogue.zh: 只是好玩，對，又被刺到。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: I am sorry, that was sharp.
dialogue.zh: 抱歉，那句話很尖。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: No, sharp is what I need.
dialogue.zh: 不，我就是需要尖一點。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Then here is tomorrow's problem.
dialogue.zh: 那明天的麻煩也在這裡。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Bored at the bus stop again.
dialogue.zh: 在車站又無聊起來了。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Bring the crossword from the kitchen.
dialogue.zh: 把廚房那張字謎帶來。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: A paper crossword, you still buy those?
dialogue.phonetic: /ə ˈpeɪpər ˈkrɔswɜːrd, ju stɪl baɪ ðoʊz?/
dialogue.zh: 紙本字謎？你還在買？

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Nine cents at the corner shop.
dialogue.zh: 巷口小店九毛錢。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: I finished one whole page today.
dialogue.zh: 我今天寫完整整一頁。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: With a pencil, like a child?
dialogue.zh: 用鉛筆，像小孩一樣？

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Blue pencil, and no phone out.
dialogue.zh: 藍鉛筆，手機也沒拿出來。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: That is the win, write it down.
dialogue.phonetic: /ðæt ɪz ðə wɪn, raɪt ɪt daʊn./
dialogue.zh: 那才是贏了，寫下來。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: I watered the plants twice.
dialogue.zh: 我幫植物澆了兩次水。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: The basil survived, that is growth.
dialogue.zh: 羅勒活下來了，那是成長。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: It was dying, now it smells.
dialogue.zh: 它本來快死了，現在有香氣。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Hands busy, nose full, no screen.
dialogue.zh: 手有事、鼻子飽飽的，沒看螢幕。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Give me the app list back.
dialogue.zh: 把 App 清單還給我。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Here, count with me what stayed.
dialogue.zh: 給，跟我一起數還留下了什麼。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Fourteen icons, all still here.
dialogue.zh: 十四個圖示，全都還在。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Fourteen, that is a small phone.
dialogue.zh: 十四個，那算一支克制的手機。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: What about my sketch pad?
dialogue.zh: 那我的素描本呢？

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: It sits by the couch, use it.
dialogue.phonetic: /ɪt sɪts baɪ ðə kaʊtʃ, juz ɪt./
dialogue.zh: 它就在沙發邊，用呀。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: I drew your bad haircut today.
dialogue.zh: 我今天畫了你那個糟糕的髮型。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Bad? That sketch is honest.
dialogue.zh: 糟糕？那張畫很誠實。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: One app down, how many hours?
dialogue.zh: 關掉一個，省下幾小時？

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: The report says one hour back.
dialogue.zh: 報告顯示回來了一個小時。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: One hour is a whole long walk.
dialogue.phonetic: /wʌn ˈaʊər ɪz ə hoʊl lɔŋ wɔk./
dialogue.zh: 一個小時，夠走一趟長路了。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Spend it on soup, or on walks.
dialogue.phonetic: /spɛnd ɪt ɑn sup, ɔr ɑn wɔks./
dialogue.zh: 拿去煮湯，或拿去散步。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: The urge still comes at night.
dialogue.zh: 那股衝動晚上還是會來。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Then stand up, drink some water.
dialogue.zh: 那就站起來，喝點水。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Water, then brush my teeth early.
dialogue.zh: 喝完水就早點刷牙。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Early brushing ends most scrolling.
dialogue.zh: 早刷牙結束大多數滑動。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Sam sent his empty page today.
dialogue.zh: 山姆今天傳了他空掉的畫面。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: He deleted two, that is brave.
dialogue.zh: 他刪了兩個，真勇敢。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Brave, or he will cry by noon.
dialogue.phonetic: /breɪv, ɔːr hi wɪl kraɪ baɪ nun./
dialogue.zh: 真勇敢，或他中午就哭。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: He texted me, he is fine.
dialogue.zh: 他傳訊給我，說他沒事。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Look, the icon is really gone.
dialogue.zh: 你看，那個圖示真的不見了。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Gone, and the sky did not fall.
dialogue.phonetic: /ɡɔn, ænd ðə skaɪ dɪd nɑt fɔl./
dialogue.zh: 不見了，天也沒塌下來。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Nothing bad happened in one day.
dialogue.zh: 一天之內沒有壞事。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Try two weeks, then brag to me.
dialogue.phonetic: /traɪ tu wiːks, ðɛn bræɡ tu mi./
dialogue.zh: 試兩週，再來跟我炫耀。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: I will brag quietly, that is me.
dialogue.phonetic: /aɪ wɪl bræɡ ˈkwaɪətli, ðæt ɪz mi./
dialogue.zh: 我會安靜地炫耀，那是我。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Quiet bragging is my favorite kind.
dialogue.zh: 安靜炫耀是我最愛的那種。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: So, one app closed tonight.
dialogue.zh: 所以今晚關掉了一個 App。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Closed, and the fridge list is longer.
dialogue.phonetic: /kloʊzd, ænd ðə frɪdʒ lɪst ɪz ˈlɔŋɡər./
dialogue.zh: 關掉了，冰箱清單也更長了。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: My screen just turned orange.
dialogue.zh: 我的螢幕剛剛變橘了。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: That is night mode, it is nine.
dialogue.phonetic: /ðæt ɪs naɪt moʊd, ɪt ɪz naɪn./
dialogue.zh: 那是夜間模式，九點了。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: I did not ask for orange.
dialogue.zh: 我沒要求要橘色。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: It saves your eyes at night.
dialogue.zh: 它晚上在保護你的眼睛。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: My eyes do feel less dry.
dialogue.zh: 我的眼睛確實比較不乾。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Blue light dries them out.
dialogue.zh: 藍光把水分抽乾了。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Set it on a schedule.
dialogue.zh: 把它排進時程裡。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Sunset on, sunrise off, done.
dialogue.zh: 日落開、日出關，搞定。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Six fourteen tonight, that is early.
dialogue.zh: 今天六點十四，還挺早。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: It starts before the soup is done.
dialogue.phonetic: /ɪt stɑrts bɪˈfɔr ðə sup ɪz dʌn./
dialogue.zh: 它在湯煮好之前就啟動了。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: It also dims the whole screen.
dialogue.zh: 它也會把整個螢幕調暗。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Turn the bar down one step.
dialogue.zh: 把亮度條往下降一格。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: This is dark, I am squinting.
dialogue.zh: 這太暗了，我在瞇眼。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Raise the text size instead.
dialogue.zh: 那就把字體放大。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Big letters, small lamp, perfect.
dialogue.zh: 大字、小燈，完美。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Your lamp is the one by the bed.
dialogue.phonetic: /jʊər læmp ɪz ðə wʌn baɪ ðə bɛd./
dialogue.zh: 你的燈就是床頭那一盞。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: It has a warm bulb already.
dialogue.zh: 那盞本來就是暖色燈泡。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Then your room is half set.
dialogue.zh: 那你房間已經設定好一半。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Half? What is the other half?
dialogue.zh: 一半？另一半是什麼？

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: The white page inside each app.
dialogue.zh: 每個 App 裡面那個白頁面。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Some pages stay white anyway.
dialogue.zh: 有些頁面還是純白的。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: The weather app ignores you.
dialogue.zh: 天氣 App 完全不聽你的。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: It burns my eyes at midnight.
dialogue.zh: 半夜它閃得我眼睛痛。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Move it into the dark folder.
dialogue.zh: 把它搬進那個深色資料夾。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Dark mode needs one tap each.
dialogue.zh: 深色模式每個都要點一下。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Tap yours now, I will wait.
dialogue.zh: 你現在就點，我等你。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Done, the page sank to gray.
dialogue.zh: 好了，頁面沉成灰色了。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Gray is softer on tired eyes.
dialogue.zh: 灰色對疲累的眼睛比較柔和。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: My eyes stopped watering, truly.
dialogue.zh: 我的眼睛真的不再流淚了。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: You told me that on Tuesday.
dialogue.zh: 你週二就跟我說過這個了。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Every night, at eleven.
dialogue.zh: 每個晚上，十一點。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Eleven is when the real scroll starts.
dialogue.phonetic: /ɪˈlɛvən ɪz wɛn ðə ril skroʊl stɑrts./
dialogue.zh: 十一點才是真正開滑的時候。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Look far away every twenty minutes.
dialogue.zh: 每廿分鐘就往遠處看。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: The tree outside counts, right?
dialogue.zh: 外面那棵樹也算嗎？

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: The tree is perfect, look now.
dialogue.zh: 那棵樹最合適，快看。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: My neck hurts from that dip.
dialogue.zh: 低頭讓我的脖子很痠。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Hold the phone up at chest.
dialogue.zh: 把手機舉到胸口高。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Chest height, that is a rule.
dialogue.zh: 胸口的高度，這算一條規矩。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Try gray screen for one evening.
dialogue.zh: 試一個晚上把畫面變灰階。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Gray screen? Like an old box?
dialogue.zh: 灰階畫面？像舊電視盒？

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: No color at all, just gray.
dialogue.zh: 一點顏色都沒有，只有灰。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Then my food photos look sad.
dialogue.zh: 那我的美食照片會很可憐。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Boring photos keep you calm.
dialogue.zh: 無聊的照片讓你平靜。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Calm sounds boring from you.
dialogue.zh: 從你嘴裡聽到平靜真稀奇。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: I liked color, but gray works.
dialogue.zh: 我喜歡顏色，但灰色有用。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: The video app in gray?
dialogue.zh: 那個影片 App 也變灰？

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: It looked dead, I left fast.
dialogue.zh: 它看起來死氣沉沉，我馬上退出。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Dead screens are good fences.
dialogue.zh: 無趣的螢幕就是好圍欄。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Fences, nice, who built that one?
dialogue.zh: 圍欄，不錯，誰搭的？

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: You did, at eight p.m. today.
dialogue.phonetic: /ju dɪd, æt eɪt pi ɛm təˈdeɪ./
dialogue.zh: 你自己呀，在今晚八點。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: My battery died, so I waited.
dialogue.zh: 我電池沒電了，只好等。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Waiting felt long, or short?
dialogue.zh: 等待感覺很長，還是很短？

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Short, I read the whole label.
dialogue.zh: 很短，我把標籤全讀完了。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: The tea box label? Really?
dialogue.zh: 茶葉盒的標籤？真的假的？

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: It has a poem on the back.
dialogue.phonetic: /ɪt hæz ə ˈpoʊəm ɑn ðə bæk./
dialogue.zh: 背面印了一首短詩。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Read it, I own that box too.
dialogue.phonetic: /rid ɪt, aɪ ˈoʊn ðæt bɑks tuː./
dialogue.zh: 唸給我聽，那盒我也有。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Slow mornings make rich days.
dialogue.zh: 慢的早晨讓日子變富足。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: That fits on a fridge note.
dialogue.zh: 這句話剛好寫在冰箱上。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Should gray stay for always?
dialogue.zh: 灰階要一直開著嗎？

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Only after eight, color by day.
dialogue.zh: 只在八點後開，白天要顏色。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Night mode on the laptop too?
dialogue.zh: 筆電也要夜間模式嗎？

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Yes, and lower it at nine.
dialogue.zh: 要，而且九點往下調。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: It glows like a small fire.
dialogue.zh: 它像小火一樣發亮。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Warm light, then sleep comes easy.
dialogue.zh: 暖光一來，就容易睡著。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: The television gets the same rule.
dialogue.zh: 電視也用同一條規矩。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Hall lamp on, big light off.
dialogue.zh: 走廊小燈開，大燈關掉。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Our old place, the big light always on.
dialogue.phonetic: /ˈaʊər oʊld pleɪs, ðə bɪɡ laɪt ˈɔlweɪz ɑn./
dialogue.zh: 我們以前住的地方，大燈永遠開著。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Since we moved here, that changed.
dialogue.zh: 從我們搬來之後就改了。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Also, the alarm screen is bright.
dialogue.zh: 還有，鬧鐘的螢幕很刺眼。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Buy a small clock, dim the numbers.
dialogue.phonetic: /baɪ ə smɔːl klɑk, dɪm ðə ˈnʌmbərz./
dialogue.zh: 買個小時鐘，把數字調暗。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Twelve dollars, and no screen.
dialogue.zh: 十二塊錢，而且沒螢幕。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Cheap, buy it tonight online.
dialogue.zh: 很便宜，今晚就在網路下單。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: I will pick the warm orange one.
dialogue.phonetic: /aɪ wɪl pɪk ðə wɔːrm ˈɔrɪndʒ wʌn./
dialogue.zh: 我要選那個暖橘色的。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Orange clocks wake you gently.
dialogue.zh: 橘色的鐘會溫柔叫你起床。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Set it across the room, though.
dialogue.zh: 不過要放在房間另一頭。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Across the room means your feet move.
dialogue.phonetic: /əˈkrɔs ðə rum minz jʊər fit muːv./
dialogue.zh: 放另一頭代表你得用腳。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Feet, not thumbs, in the morning.
dialogue.zh: 早上要用腳，不是拇指。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: That is the whole trick, friend.
dialogue.zh: 那就是全部的訣竅，朋友。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Do not call me friend at nine.
dialogue.phonetic: /du nɑt kɔl mi frɛnd æt naɪn./
dialogue.zh: 九點的時候別叫我朋友。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Nine is your gentle hour.
dialogue.zh: 九點是你柔和的那個時段。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: My books need a light, though.
dialogue.zh: 我的書還是要一盞燈。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Clip one on the shelf edge.
dialogue.zh: 夾一個在書架邊緣。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: A small book light, yes.
dialogue.zh: 一個小小的書燈，好。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Warm, dim, and not above your head.
dialogue.phonetic: /wɔːrm, dɪm, ænd nɑt əˈbʌv jʊər hɛd./
dialogue.zh: 暖色、昏暗，別在頭頂上。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: So tonight: orange screen, small lamp.
dialogue.zh: 所以今晚：橘螢幕、小燈。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: And the phone faces down.
dialogue.zh: 然後手機螢幕朝下放。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Face down, my thumbs can rest.
dialogue.zh: 朝下放，我的拇指能休息。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Rest them, they worked overtime.
dialogue.zh: 讓它們歇著，它們加班太久了。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Overtime, that is the right word.
dialogue.zh: 加班，就是那個詞。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: So pay them one quiet night.
dialogue.zh: 所以賠它們一個安靜的夜晚。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: The warm screen, like grandmother's paper.
dialogue.zh: 暖暖的螢幕，像阿嬤的舊紙。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Then read slower, the app can wait.
dialogue.phonetic: /ðɛn rid ˈsloʊər, ðə æp kən weɪt./
dialogue.zh: 那就慢慢讀，App 等得起。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Eight fifty, the room looks calm.
dialogue.zh: 八點五十，房間看起來很安靜。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Calm room, warm screen, good.
dialogue.zh: 安靜的房間、暖暖的螢幕，很好。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: I almost forgot to eat.
dialogue.zh: 我差點忘記要吃飯。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Dinner waits, but the stove does not.
dialogue.phonetic: /ˈdɪnər weɪts, bʌt ðə stoʊv dʌz nɑt./
dialogue.zh: 飯可以等，爐子不等人。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Right, up and cook, then phone down.
dialogue.phonetic: /raɪt, ʌp ænd kʊk, ðɛn foʊn daʊn./
dialogue.zh: 好，起來煮飯，手機放下。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Leave it face down on the table.
dialogue.phonetic: /liv ɪt feɪs daʊn ɑn ðə ˈteɪbəl./
dialogue.zh: 就讓它朝下放在桌上。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Face down, night mode, one app gone.
dialogue.phonetic: /feɪs daʊn, naɪt moʊd, wʌn æp ɡɔn./
dialogue.zh: 朝下放、夜間模式、一個 App 沒了。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Three changes, one evening, we are ahead.
dialogue.phonetic: /θriː ˈtʃeɪndʒɪz, wʌn ˈivnɪŋ, wi ɑːr əˈhɛd./
dialogue.zh: 三項改變，一個晚上，我們領先了。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Pass the blue bowl, please.
dialogue.zh: 把那個藍碗遞給我好嗎？

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: The small one, or the big one?
dialogue.phonetic: /ðə smɔːl wʌn, ɔːr ðə bɪɡ wʌn?/
dialogue.zh: 小的那個，還是大的？

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: The big one, it holds two phones.
dialogue.phonetic: /ðə bɪɡ wʌn, ɪt hoʊldz tu foʊnz./
dialogue.zh: 大的那個，裝得下兩支手機。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Two phones? For our dinner?
dialogue.zh: 兩支？在我們吃晚飯時？

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Yes, from the first bite to the last.
dialogue.phonetic: /jɛs, frʌm ðə fɜːrst baɪt tu ðə læst./
dialogue.zh: 對，從第一口到最後一口。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: That is a strange table rule.
dialogue.zh: 這條桌子規矩真奇怪。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Strange, but I read it in a book.
dialogue.phonetic: /streɪndʒ, bʌt aɪ rid ɪt ɪn ə bʊk./
dialogue.zh: 奇怪，但我是在書上讀到的。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: A real paper book, who knew.
dialogue.zh: 真正的紙本書，誰料到的。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: My hand is already in my pocket.
dialogue.phonetic: /maɪ hænd ɪz ɔlˈrɛdi ɪn maɪ ˈpɑkɪt./
dialogue.zh: 我的手已經伸進口袋了。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Then put it in the bowl, gently.
dialogue.phonetic: /ðɛn pʊt ɪt ɪn ðə boʊl, ˈdʒɛntli./
dialogue.zh: 那就放進碗裡，輕輕的。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: It buzzed, I felt it twice.
dialogue.zh: 它震了，我感覺到兩次。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Let it buzz, the soup is hot.
dialogue.phonetic: /lɛt ɪt bʌz, ðə sup ɪz hɑt./
dialogue.zh: 讓它震吧，湯很燙。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Who texts at seven, anyway?
dialogue.zh: 反正誰會在七點傳訊？

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Probably Sam with a funny link.
dialogue.zh: 大概是山姆傳好笑的連結。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: He can wait until dessert.
dialogue.zh: 他可以等到甜點時間。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Exactly, dessert is at eight.
dialogue.zh: 就是呀，甜點在八點。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: What if your mother calls now?
dialogue.zh: 如果你媽現在打來怎麼辦？

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Let it ring, she is eating soon.
dialogue.phonetic: /lɛt ɪt rɪŋ, ʃi ɪz ˈitɪŋ sun./
dialogue.zh: 讓它響，她很快就要吃了。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Only three numbers ring right through.
dialogue.zh: 只有三個號碼能直接響進來。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Good, that is a fair exception.
dialogue.zh: 好，那是合理的例外。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: My two are my mother and Sam.
dialogue.phonetic: /maɪ tuː ɑːr maɪ ˈmʌðər ænd sæm./
dialogue.zh: 我的兩個是我媽跟山姆。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Add your boss, work still exists.
dialogue.zh: 把你老闆加上，還是要工作。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Three, then, and nothing else.
dialogue.zh: 那就三個，別的都不算。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Good, now the bowl is full.
dialogue.zh: 好，現在碗裝滿了。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Day one, we both reached at once.
dialogue.phonetic: /deɪ wʌn, wi boʊθ riːtʃt æt wʌns./
dialogue.zh: 第一天，我們倆同時伸手。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: You grabbed my wrist, it was funny.
dialogue.phonetic: /ju ɡræbd maɪ rɪst, ɪt wʌz ˈfʌni./
dialogue.zh: 你抓住我的手腕，很好笑。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: We laughed and kept eating.
dialogue.zh: 我們笑一笑，繼續吃。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: And nobody checked anything.
dialogue.zh: 沒有人偷看任何東西。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: I asked about your sister.
dialogue.zh: 我問了你姊姊的事。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: And I told the whole story.
dialogue.zh: 然後我把整件事講完了。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Twelve minutes of just talking.
dialogue.zh: 十二分鐘純粹在聊天。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Longest talk in a month, I think.
dialogue.phonetic: /ˈlɔŋɡəst tɔk ɪn ə mʌnθ, aɪ θɪŋk./
dialogue.zh: 我想這是這月最久的一次。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: The soup burned, did you smell it?
dialogue.phonetic: /ðə sup bɜːrnd, dɪd ju smɛl ɪt?/
dialogue.zh: 湯燒焦了，你聞到了嗎？

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: I did, that is why we ordered.
dialogue.phonetic: /aɪ dɪd, ðæt ɪz waɪ wi ˈɔːrdərd./
dialogue.zh: 我聞到了，所以我們才點外賣。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: The doorbell, our noodles arrived.
dialogue.zh: 門鈴響了，我們的面到了。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Leave the phone, I will open.
dialogue.zh: 手機放著，我去開門。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: The driver texted the wrong gate.
dialogue.zh: 司機傳訊說他走錯側門。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: One tap for him, then the bowl.
dialogue.phonetic: /wʌn tæp fɔːr hɪm, ðɛn ðə boʊl./
dialogue.zh: 回他一下就好，然後放碗裡。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Twenty seconds, not twenty minutes.
dialogue.zh: 二十秒，不是二十分鐘。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: You were back in twelve, honestly.
dialogue.zh: 老實說你十二秒就回來了。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Mia called at eight, I missed her.
dialogue.phonetic: /ˈmiə kɔld æt eɪt, aɪ mɪst hɜːr./
dialogue.zh: 米亞八點打來，我沒接到。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Call her back now, it is allowed.
dialogue.phonetic: /kɔl hɜːr bæk naʊ, ɪt ɪz əˈlaʊd./
dialogue.zh: 現在回給她，這是允許的。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: She got the job in Taichung.
dialogue.zh: 她拿到台中的工作了。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Big news, and you missed it twice?
dialogue.phonetic: /bɪɡ nuz, ænd ju mɪst ɪt twaɪs?/
dialogue.zh: 這麼大的消息，你錯過兩次？

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: I was in the bathroom, honestly.
dialogue.zh: 老實說，我剛剛在浴室。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Then text her, then wash that bowl.
dialogue.phonetic: /ðɛn tɛkst hɜːr, ðɛn wɑʃ ðæt boʊl./
dialogue.zh: 那先傳訊給她，再去洗碗。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Why must I wash the bowl?
dialogue.zh: 為什麼一定是我洗這個碗？

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: You grabbed twice, I grabbed once.
dialogue.zh: 你伸手兩次，我只有一次。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: The bowl is a judge now.
dialogue.zh: 這個碗現在變成裁判了。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: A fair judge, it counts in silence.
dialogue.phonetic: /ə fɛr dʒʌdʒ, ɪt kaʊnts ɪn ˈsaɪləns./
dialogue.zh: 公平的裁判，安靜地記數。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Dishes for a week, that is the bet.
dialogue.phonetic: /ˈdɪʃɪz fɔːr ə wik, ðæt ɪz ðə bɛt./
dialogue.zh: 洗一週的碗，就是我們的賭注。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: You are losing, my hands stay clean.
dialogue.phonetic: /ju ɑːr ˈluzɪŋ, maɪ hændz steɪ klin./
dialogue.zh: 你快輸了，我的手都很乾淨。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Three nights, and my sleeves are wet.
dialogue.phonetic: /θriː naɪts, ænd maɪ slivz ɑːr wɛt./
dialogue.zh: 三個晚上了，我的袖子都濕了。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Wet sleeves, dry screens, good trade.
dialogue.zh: 袖子濕、螢幕乾，好交易。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Sam heard about the bowl, obviously.
dialogue.zh: 山姆當然聽說了這個碗。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: He called it a cute little trick.
dialogue.phonetic: /hi kɔld ɪt ə kjuːt ˈlɪtəl trɪk./
dialogue.zh: 他說是可愛的小把戲。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Cute? He bought a bowl today.
dialogue.zh: 可愛？他今天自己買了碗。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: A white one, for his whole family.
dialogue.phonetic: /ə waɪt wʌn, fɔːr hɪz hoʊl ˈfæməli./
dialogue.zh: 白的那個，他們全家一起用。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Four phones in one white bowl.
dialogue.zh: 四支手機在一個白碗裡。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: His niece cried, then they ate.
dialogue.zh: 他姪女先哭了，然後才吃飯。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: My mother visits on Friday.
dialogue.zh: 我媽星期五要來住。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Then we set a third bowl out.
dialogue.phonetic: /ðɛn wi sɛt ə θɜːrd boʊl aʊt./
dialogue.zh: 那我們就擺第三個碗。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: She will say it is nonsense.
dialogue.zh: 她會說這一點道理也沒有。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Let her say it, with soup in front.
dialogue.phonetic: /lɛt hɜːr seɪ ɪt, wɪt sup ɪn frʌnt./
dialogue.zh: 讓她說，她面前還有湯。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: She reads recipes on her phone.
dialogue.zh: 她都在手機上看食譜。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Then do not let her cook.
dialogue.zh: 那就別讓她下廚。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Both of us burned something here.
dialogue.zh: 我們倆都在這廚房燒壞東西。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Twice, and the smoke alarm knows.
dialogue.zh: 兩次了，煙霧警報器都知道。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Friday, then, three bowls, one table.
dialogue.zh: 那就星期五，三個碗、一張桌。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: I will make the noodles she likes.
dialogue.phonetic: /aɪ wɪl meɪk ðə ˈnudəlz ʃi laɪks./
dialogue.zh: 我來煮她喜歡的那種麵。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: She likes them soft, remember.
dialogue.zh: 她喜歡軟一點的，記得喔。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Soft, and no phone in the kitchen.
dialogue.phonetic: /sɔft, ænd noʊ foʊn ɪn ðə ˈkɪtʃɪn./
dialogue.zh: 軟的，而且廚房不帶手機。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: None? Mine is on the counter.
dialogue.zh: 一支都不行？我的在流理台上。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Move it to the bowl, right now.
dialogue.phonetic: /muv ɪt tu ðə boʊl, raɪt naʊ./
dialogue.zh: 現在就把它挪進碗裡。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: While I chop, at least the timer.
dialogue.phonetic: /waɪl aɪ tʃɑp, æt list ðə ˈtaɪmər./
dialogue.zh: 我切菜時，至少讓計時器響。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Paper timer, the yellow one.
dialogue.zh: 用那個黃色機械計時器。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: It rings like an old oven.
dialogue.zh: 它響起來像一台舊烤箱。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Old ovens made good dinners.
dialogue.zh: 舊烤箱做出過很好的晚餐。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Ninety minutes of quiet cooking.
dialogue.zh: 九十分鐘安靜地煮飯。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: I heard the cat outside again.
dialogue.zh: 我又聽見外面那隻貓了。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: The neighbor's cat, the gray one.
dialogue.zh: 鄰居那隻貓，灰色的那隻。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: It waits for our fallen bits.
dialogue.zh: 牠在等我們掉下來的菜屑。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Back to the bowl, our rule.
dialogue.zh: 回到碗這件事，我們的規矩。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Our rule, from first bite to plates.
dialogue.phonetic: /ˈaʊər rul, frʌm fɜːrst baɪt tu pleɪts./
dialogue.zh: 我們的規矩，從第一口到收盤。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: My phone has been in there one hour.
dialogue.phonetic: /maɪ foʊn hæz bɪn ɪn ðɛr wʌn ˈaʊər./
dialogue.zh: 我的手機在碗裡一個小時了。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: And you are still talking to me.
dialogue.phonetic: /ænd ju ɑːr stɪl ˈtɔkɪŋ tu mi./
dialogue.zh: 而你還在跟我說話呀。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Barely, I keep looking at the bowl.
dialogue.phonetic: /ˈbɛrli, aɪ kip ˈlʊkɪŋ æt ðə boʊl./
dialogue.zh: 勉強，我一直在看那個碗。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Restless, that is the first stage.
dialogue.zh: 坐立難安，那是第一個階段。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Stage one, then stage what?
dialogue.zh: 第一階段，然後是第幾階段？

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Stage two is forgetting it exists.
dialogue.zh: 第二階段是忘了它存在。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: I forgot it for eleven minutes.
dialogue.zh: 我有十一分鐘忘了它。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: A record, and the noodles were good.
dialogue.phonetic: /ə ˈrɛkərd, ænd ðə ˈnudəlz wɜːr ɡʊd./
dialogue.zh: 破紀錄了，而且麵很好吃。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: The soup was plain, the noodles saved us.
dialogue.phonetic: /ðə sup wʌz pleɪn, ðə ˈnudəlz seɪvd ʌs./
dialogue.zh: 湯很普通，是那碗麵救了我們。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Friday, then, and my noodles again.
dialogue.zh: 那就星期五，再煮一次我的麵。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Bring the good bowls, both of them.
dialogue.phonetic: /brɪŋ ðə ɡʊd boʊlz, boʊθ əv ðɛm./
dialogue.zh: 把好看的碗拿來，兩個都要。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Blue and white, they match nothing.
dialogue.zh: 藍色配白色，什麼都不搭。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: They match phones, that is enough.
dialogue.zh: 它們跟手機很搭，就夠了。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Enough rules for one dinner party.
dialogue.zh: 一頓飯的規矩已經夠多了。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Only one rule, the bowl in the middle.
dialogue.phonetic: /ˈoʊnli wʌn rul, ðə boʊl ɪn ðə ˈmɪdəl./
dialogue.zh: 只有一條規矩：碗擺中間。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Middle of the table, middle of us.
dialogue.phonetic: /ˈmɪdəl əv ðə ˈteɪbəl, ˈmɪdəl əv ʌs./
dialogue.zh: 在桌子中間，也在我們中間。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: It is nine, the moon appeared.
dialogue.zh: 九點了，月亮圖示出現了。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: That moon means do not disturb.
dialogue.zh: 那個月亮代表請勿打擾。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Do not disturb, what a name.
dialogue.zh: 請勿打擾，什麼名字呀。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: It is honest, at least.
dialogue.zh: 起碼它很誠實。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: So it silences everything now?
dialogue.zh: 所以它現在什麼都不讓響？

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Calls and texts sleep, alarms do not.
dialogue.phonetic: /kɔlz ænd tɛksts slip, əˈlɑrmz du nɑt./
dialogue.zh: 來電和訊息睡覺，鬧鐘不會。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Only my alarms, good.
dialogue.zh: 只有鬧鐘會響，很好。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: You sleep in peace, we are adults.
dialogue.phonetic: /ju slip ɪn pis, wi ɑːr əˈdʌlts./
dialogue.zh: 你可以安靜地睡，我們是大人。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Adults hide from group chats.
dialogue.zh: 大人也會躲開聊天群。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Then say it kindly, nine a.m.
dialogue.phonetic: /ðɛn seɪ ɪt ˈkaɪndli, naɪn eɪ ɛm./
dialogue.zh: 那就好好說，明天上午九點。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Who goes first, you or me?
dialogue.zh: 誰先設定，你還是我？

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: You, since your chat never sleeps.
dialogue.zh: 你吧，你的聊天群從不睡覺。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Here, tap focus, then do not disturb.
dialogue.phonetic: /hɪr, tæp ˈfoʊkəs, ðɛn du nɑt dɪˈstɜːrb./
dialogue.zh: 這裡，點專注，再請勿打擾。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: It asks which people may ring.
dialogue.zh: 它問哪些人可以打進來。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: My mother, Sam, and my boss.
dialogue.zh: 我媽、山姆，還有我老闆。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Your boss? Will he ring at night?
dialogue.phonetic: /jʊər bɔs? wɪl hi rɪŋ æt naɪt?/
dialogue.zh: 你老闆？他半夜會打來嗎？

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Once a year, at seven a.m.
dialogue.phonetic: /wʌns ə jɪr, æt ˈsɛvən eɪ ɛm./
dialogue.zh: 一年一次，在早上七點。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Keep it, some calls are real.
dialogue.zh: 留著吧，有些電話是真的急。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: It also rings if they call twice.
dialogue.phonetic: /ɪt ˈɔlsoʊ rɪŋz ɪf ðeɪ kɔl twaɪs./
dialogue.zh: 如果同一個人打兩次，也會響。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Sam will call twice in one minute.
dialogue.phonetic: /sæm wɪl kɔl twaɪs ɪn wʌn ˈmɪnɪt./
dialogue.zh: 山姆會在一分鐘內打兩次。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Then Sam can learn some patience.
dialogue.zh: 那山姆就得學學耐心。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: He has no patience, ask his mom.
dialogue.phonetic: /hi hæz noʊ ˈpeɪʃəns, æsk hɪz mɑm./
dialogue.zh: 他一點耐心都沒有，問他媽。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Nine oh five already, quiet house.
dialogue.zh: 九點零五了，房子好安靜。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Listen, even the fridge is loud.
dialogue.zh: 你聽，連冰箱都很吵。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: I keep checking for a buzz.
dialogue.zh: 我不斷在等那一下震動。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Ghost buzz again, night two.
dialogue.zh: 又是幻覺震動，第二夜了。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: My pocket felt a text that never came.
dialogue.phonetic: /maɪ ˈpɑkɪt fɛlt ə tɛkst ðæt ˈnɛvər keɪm./
dialogue.zh: 我口袋以為有訊息，其實沒有。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Your body expects the noise.
dialogue.zh: 你的身體在等那個聲音。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: What do we do with these minutes?
dialogue.phonetic: /wʌt du wi du wɪt ðiz ˈmɪnɪts?/
dialogue.zh: 這些多出來的分鐘要幹嘛？

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Nothing, that is the point of them.
dialogue.phonetic: /ˈnʌθɪŋ, ðæt ɪz ðə pɔɪnt əv ðɛm./
dialogue.zh: 什麼都不做，這就是重點。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Nothing on purpose, hmm.
dialogue.zh: 故意什麼都不做，嗯。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Sit, stretch, and hear the street.
dialogue.zh: 坐下、伸展，聽見外面的街。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: A scooter, and someone's radio.
dialogue.zh: 一台機車，還有誰的收音機。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: That is the city saying good night.
dialogue.phonetic: /ðæt ɪz ðə ˈsɪti ˈseɪɪŋ ɡʊd naɪt./
dialogue.zh: 那是城市在說晚安。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Ten twenty, still nothing buzzed.
dialogue.zh: 十點二十，什麼都沒有響。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Except mine, my phone rang once.
dialogue.zh: 除我那支，它響了一聲。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Your mother? Is it bad news?
dialogue.zh: 你媽媽嗎？是壞消息？

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: No, the doctor cleared Grandpa today.
dialogue.zh: 沒有，醫生說阿公今天能回家。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: That moon let that call through.
dialogue.zh: 多虧那個月亮，讓它響了。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Call her back, I am not sleepy.
dialogue.phonetic: /kɔl hɜːr bæk, aɪ æm nɑt ˈslipi./
dialogue.zh: 回給她吧，我還不睏。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: She talked for twenty minutes.
dialogue.zh: 她講了二十分鐘。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Twenty minutes, and no scrolling.
dialogue.zh: 二十分鐘，而且沒滑手機。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: She asked who the other voice was.
dialogue.phonetic: /ʃi æskt hu ði ˈʌðər vɔɪs wʌz./
dialogue.zh: 她問另一個聲音是誰。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: What did you say to her?
dialogue.zh: 你怎麼回答她的？

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: That it was Lucy, making soup.
dialogue.zh: 我說那是我，正在煮湯。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: She will ask about soup, forever.
dialogue.zh: 她會一直問湯這件事。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Eleven, and my eyes are heavy.
dialogue.zh: 十一點了，我的眼睛好重。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Phone in the kitchen, as we planned.
dialogue.phonetic: /foʊn ɪn ðə ˈkɪtʃɪn, æz wi plænd./
dialogue.zh: 手機放廚房，跟我們講好的。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Charging there, alarm on the clock.
dialogue.zh: 在那裡充電，鬧鐘用時鐘。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: I will knock if you need waking.
dialogue.phonetic: /aɪ wɪl nɑk ɪf ju nid ˈweɪkɪŋ./
dialogue.zh: 要是你需要我叫，我就敲門。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Seven sharp, and no snooze.
dialogue.zh: 七點整，不賴床。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: No snooze, that is new for you.
dialogue.phonetic: /noʊ snuz, ðæt ɪz nu fɔːr ju./
dialogue.zh: 不賴床，這在你身上是頭一回。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: My room feels bigger at night.
dialogue.zh: 我的房間入夜後感覺更大。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: No blue window in the dark.
dialogue.zh: 黑暗裡沒有一扇藍色的窗。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Six fifty, I slept the whole night.
dialogue.phonetic: /sɪks ˈfɪfti, aɪ slɛpt ðə hoʊl naɪt./
dialogue.zh: 六點五十，我睡了一整夜。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: The alarm clock did its job.
dialogue.zh: 那個小時鐘盡了它的責任。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: It is loud, that little orange thing.
dialogue.phonetic: /ɪt ɪz laʊd, ðæt ˈlɪtəl ˈɔrɪndʒ θɪŋ./
dialogue.zh: 那橘色小東西聲音真大。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Loud enough to beat a group chat.
dialogue.phonetic: /laʊd ɪˈnʌf tu bit ə ɡrup tʃæt./
dialogue.zh: 夠大聲，打得過一個聊天群。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Morning, how many notifications?
dialogue.zh: 早安，有多少則通知？

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: One hundred forty, mine has sixty.
dialogue.zh: 一百四十則，我的有六十。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: A hundred forty, and I was asleep.
dialogue.phonetic: /ə ˈhʌndrəd ˈfɔːrti, ænd aɪ wʌz əˈslip./
dialogue.zh: 一百四十則，我卻睡得沉沉。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Swipe once, and the whole stack is gone.
dialogue.phonetic: /swaɪp wʌns, ænd ðə hoʊl stæk ɪz ɡɔn./
dialogue.zh: 一滑，整疊通知就不見了。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Which one was the loudest?
dialogue.zh: 哪一則最吵？

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: A sale on shoes, at two a.m.
dialogue.phonetic: /ə seɪl ɑn ʃuz, æt tu eɪ ɛm./
dialogue.zh: 凌晨兩點的特價鞋子。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Shoes do not need my morning.
dialogue.zh: 鞋子不需要我的早晨。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Unsubscribe, that is one less.
dialogue.zh: 退訂吧，那就少一則。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: I unsubscribed to eleven things.
dialogue.zh: 我退了十一個訂閱。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Eleven! That is a small war.
dialogue.zh: 十一個！那是一場小戰爭。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: The store app asks every day.
dialogue.zh: 那個商店 App 天天都問。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Ask it to stop, in its own settings.
dialogue.phonetic: /æsk ɪt tu stɑp, ɪn ɪts oʊn ˈsɛtɪŋz./
dialogue.zh: 在它的設定裡叫它安靜。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Nine in the morning, no cap?
dialogue.zh: 早上九點，沒有上限嗎？

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: No cap, but the tea comes first.
dialogue.phonetic: /noʊ kæp, bʌt ðə ti kʌmz fɜrst./
dialogue.zh: 沒上限，但茶要先來。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Sam sent a photo of his bowl.
dialogue.phonetic: /sæm sɛnt ə ˈfoʊtoʊ əv hɪz boʊl./
dialogue.zh: 山姆傳了他那個碗的照片。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: With four phones, and one note.
dialogue.zh: 四支手機，加一張紙條。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: The note says seven fifteen.
dialogue.zh: 紙條上寫著七點十五。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: He set his quiet hour early.
dialogue.zh: 他提早設了自己的安靜時段。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: He also asked for my code.
dialogue.zh: 他也跟我要那組密碼。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Tell him to make his own.
dialogue.zh: 跟他說，自己設一組。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Nine p.m., do not disturb.
dialogue.zh: 晚上九點，請勿打擾。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: It is our quiet doorbell now.
dialogue.zh: 它現在是我們無聲的門鈴。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Did you sleep better, honestly?
dialogue.zh: 說實話，你睡得好一點了嗎？

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: One long stretch, no midnight check.
dialogue.zh: 一覺到天亮，沒有半夜查看。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: No midnight, that is new ground.
dialogue.zh: 沒有半夜醒來，這是頭一回。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: New ground needs soft steps, you know.
dialogue.phonetic: /nu ɡraʊnd nidz sɔft stɛps, ju noʊ./
dialogue.zh: 新的地面要腳步輕一點，你知道的。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: The report drops again, I bet.
dialogue.zh: 我賭報告的數字又掉了。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Bet what, if I am right?
dialogue.zh: 賭什麼，如果是我對了呢？

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: My dish week against your big bowl.
dialogue.phonetic: /maɪ dɪʃ wik əˈɡɛnst jʊər bɪɡ boʊl./
dialogue.zh: 我洗一週的碗，賭你那隻大碗。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Deal, and the loser washes all week.
dialogue.phonetic: /dil, ænd ðə ˈluzər ˈwɑʃɪz ɔl wik./
dialogue.zh: 成交，輸的人洗一整週。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Saturday we walk without phones.
dialogue.zh: 星期六我們不帶手機去走路。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Ask Mia, she walks at seven.
dialogue.zh: 去問米亞，她七點走路。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: And Sam, with his white bowl.
dialogue.zh: 還有山姆，帶著他的白碗。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Bring the trail map, the paper one.
dialogue.phonetic: /brɪŋ ðə treɪl mæp, ðə ˈpeɪpər wʌn./
dialogue.zh: 把那張紙本地圖帶來。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Paper map, in my jacket pocket.
dialogue.zh: 紙本地圖，放進我的外套口袋。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Empty pocket, that is the goal.
dialogue.zh: 空空的口袋，那才是目標。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Nine p.m., the moon, and sleep.
dialogue.phonetic: /naɪn pi ɛm, ðə mun, ænd slip./
dialogue.zh: 晚上九點、月亮圖示、睡覺。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: And one real call from mother.
dialogue.zh: 還有媽媽那一通真的電話。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: She will call every Sunday now.
dialogue.zh: 她現在每個週日都會打來。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Answer fast, she waits less than you.
dialogue.phonetic: /ˈænsər fæst, ʃi weɪts lɛs ðæn juː./
dialogue.zh: 快一點接，她比你更常等。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: So, moon on at nine tonight?
dialogue.zh: 所以今晚九點開月亮？

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Nine, and the phone goes downstairs.
dialogue.zh: 九點，然後手機下樓去。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Saturday, seven fifty already.
dialogue.zh: 星期六，七點五十分了。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Put the kettle on, I pack the bag.
dialogue.phonetic: /pʊt ðə ˈkɛtl ɑn, aɪ pæk ðə bæɡ./
dialogue.zh: 壺坐上，我收拾背包。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Did we check the weather last night?
dialogue.phonetic: /dɪd wi tʃɛk ðə ˈwɛðər læst naɪt?/
dialogue.zh: 我們昨晚看過天氣了嗎？

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Clouds at noon, rain after four.
dialogue.zh: 中午多雲，四點以後下雨。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: So we leave the phone at home?
dialogue.phonetic: /soʊ wi liv ðə foʊn æt hoʊm?/
dialogue.zh: 那把手機留在家裡？

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: No, one phone, and airplane mode.
dialogue.zh: 不，帶一支，開飛航模式。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: The plane icon, I never tap it.
dialogue.phonetic: /ðə pleɪn ˈaɪkɑn, aɪ ˈnɛvər tæp ɪt./
dialogue.zh: 那個飛機圖示，我從不點。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: It kills the signal, not the camera.
dialogue.phonetic: /ɪt kilz ðə ˈsɪɡnəl, nɑt ðə ˈkæmərə./
dialogue.zh: 它切斷訊號，不是相機。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: So photos still work up there?
dialogue.zh: 所以在山上還能拍照？

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Yes, and our saved map works too.
dialogue.phonetic: /jɛs, ænd ˈaʊər seɪvd mæp wɜːrks tuː./
dialogue.zh: 能，我們存的地圖也能用。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: I saved the whole trail Friday.
dialogue.zh: 我週五就把整條路線存好了。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Offline, like a paper map inside.
dialogue.zh: 像把紙本地圖收在裡面。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Music? Can I download a podcast?
dialogue.zh: 音樂呢？我能下載一集播客嗎？

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Do it now, before the plane flies.
dialogue.phonetic: /du ɪt naʊ, bɪˈfɔːr ðə pleɪn flaɪz./
dialogue.zh: 現在就下載，趁飛機還沒飛。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: One hour of talking, saved.
dialogue.zh: 一小時的對談，存好了。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Good, then the bus will not bore us.
dialogue.phonetic: /ɡʊd, ðɛn ðə bʌs wɪl nɑt bɔr ʌs./
dialogue.zh: 好，這樣搭車就不會無聊。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Here it is, the little plane.
dialogue.zh: 就是這個，那個小飛機。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Top corner, gray and quiet.
dialogue.zh: 在最上面那角，灰灰的、安靜的。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: It feels like closing a shop.
dialogue.zh: 感覺像把店面關起來。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Closed for two days, we are rich.
dialogue.phonetic: /kloʊzd fɔːr tu deɪz, wi ɑːr rɪtʃ./
dialogue.zh: 休息兩天，我們變有錢了。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Rich in time, not in money.
dialogue.zh: 是時間有錢，不是錢。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Same feeling, different wallet.
dialogue.zh: 同樣的感覺，不一樣的錢包。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Wait, I feel naked without signal.
dialogue.zh: 等等，沒有訊號我覺得怪怪的。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: You are in a hallway, calm down.
dialogue.phonetic: /ju ɑːr ɪn ə ˈhɔlˌweɪ, kɑm daʊn./
dialogue.zh: 你只是站在走廊，冷靜一下。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: The bus came, I took no photo.
dialogue.phonetic: /ðə bʌs keɪm, aɪ tʊk noʊ ˈfoʊtoʊ./
dialogue.zh: 公車來了，我沒有拍牠。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Progress, you just rode the thing.
dialogue.zh: 進步了，你只是坐了上去。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: At the trail gate, three runners.
dialogue.zh: 在登山口，遇到三個跑步的人。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: We asked them if the top was clear.
dialogue.phonetic: /wi æskt ðɛm ɪf ðə tɑp wʌz klɪr./
dialogue.zh: 我們問山頂上清楚不清楚。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: They said wind, but good views.
dialogue.zh: 他們說有風，但展望很好。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Then we keep our eyes for those.
dialogue.phonetic: /ðɛn wi kip ˈaʊər aɪz fɔr ðoz./
dialogue.zh: 那我們就把眼睛留給風景。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: My thumb kept swiping air.
dialogue.zh: 我的拇指一直在滑空氣。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: The phantom scroll, stage three.
dialogue.zh: 幻影滑動，第三階段了。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Halfway up, we lost the path.
dialogue.zh: 爬到一半，我們迷路了。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Paper map, and one old tea stall.
dialogue.phonetic: /ˈpeɪpər mæp, ænd wʌn oʊld ti stɔl./
dialogue.zh: 紙本地圖，還有一個舊茶攤。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: The man there drew us a line.
dialogue.phonetic: /ðə mæn ðɛr dru ʌs ə laɪn./
dialogue.zh: 那位老先生幫我們畫了一條線。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: With a pencil, on our real paper.
dialogue.phonetic: /wɪt ə ˈpɛnsəl, ɑn ˈaʊər ril ˈpeɪpər./
dialogue.zh: 用鉛筆，畫在我們真的紙上。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Nine photos, that is all.
dialogue.zh: 九張照片，就這些而已。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Nine! Last month you took three hundred.
dialogue.phonetic: /naɪn! læst mʌnθ ju tʊk θriː ˈhʌndrəd./
dialogue.zh: 九張！上個月你拍三百張。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Three hundred of one cat.
dialogue.zh: 三百張都是同一隻貓。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: It was a good cat, I admit.
dialogue.phonetic: /ɪt wʌz ə ɡʊd kæt, aɪ ədˈmɪt./
dialogue.zh: 那是一隻好貓，我承認。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Lunch on a stone, no pictures.
dialogue.zh: 在石塊上吃午餐，沒拍照。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: You ate it warm, from the jar?
dialogue.phonetic: /ju eɪt ɪt wɔːrm, frʌm ðə dʒɑːr?/
dialogue.zh: 你吃的還是溫的，從罐子裡？

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Two kites, one dog, ten kids.
dialogue.zh: 兩隻風箏、一隻狗、十個小孩。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: The dog ran to our sandwiches.
dialogue.zh: 那隻狗衝向我們的三明治。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: We hid the bread, we won.
dialogue.zh: 我們把麵包藏起來，我們贏了。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Victory over a very small dog.
dialogue.zh: 戰勝了一隻很小的狗。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Three forty, no signal check.
dialogue.zh: 三點四十，我沒查訊號。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: How does a silent phone feel?
dialogue.zh: 一支不說話的手機感覺如何？

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Like a stone inside my bag.
dialogue.zh: 像我包包裡有一顆石頭。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Heavy bag, light head, that is fair.
dialogue.phonetic: /ˈhɛvi bæɡ, laɪt hɛd, ðæt ɪz fɛr./
dialogue.zh: 包包沉沉、腦袋輕輕的，很划算。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Home at four ten, battery ninety-six.
dialogue.phonetic: /hoʊm æt fɔːr tɛn, ˈbætri ˈnɑɪnti sɪks./
dialogue.zh: 四點十分到家，電量九十六。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Ninety-six! We normally land at forty.
dialogue.phonetic: /ˈnɑɪnti sɪks! wi ˈnɔːrməli lænd æt ˈfɔːrti./
dialogue.zh: 九十六！我們平常只剩四十。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Three calls, twelve messages, no fires.
dialogue.zh: 三通電話、十二則訊息，沒有火災。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Sam wrote: did you two disappear?
dialogue.zh: 山姆寫：你們兩個失蹤了嗎？

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: His message is two days old now.
dialogue.phonetic: /hɪz ˈmɛsɪdʒ ɪz tu deɪz oʊld naʊ./
dialogue.zh: 他那則訊息放了兩天。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Reply slowly, that is practice.
dialogue.zh: 慢慢回，這就是在練習。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Your mother left one voicemail.
dialogue.zh: 你媽留了一則語音信箱。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Play it, I will pour the tea.
dialogue.phonetic: /pleɪ ɪt, aɪ wɪl pɔːr ðə tiː./
dialogue.zh: 播放吧，我來倒茶。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: She wants the soup pot back.
dialogue.zh: 她想把湯鍋拿回去。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: That is not urgent, Sunday is fine.
dialogue.phonetic: /ðæt ɪz nɑt ˈɜːrdʒənt, ˈsʌndeɪ ɪz faɪn./
dialogue.zh: 那不急，週日再說就好。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Mia saw our late reply, luckily.
dialogue.zh: 米亞看見我們晚回，還好。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: She invited us for next month.
dialogue.zh: 她邀請我們下個月過去。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: A whole day, no screen at all.
dialogue.phonetic: /ə hoʊl deɪ, noʊ skrin æt ɔl./
dialogue.zh: 一整天，完全沒看螢幕。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: One day, that is what we planned.
dialogue.phonetic: /wʌn deɪ, ðæt ɪz wʌt wi plænd./
dialogue.zh: 就一天，那是我們的計畫。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Should we try both weekend days?
dialogue.zh: 兩個週末都要試嗎？

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Saturday only, Sunday needs messages.
dialogue.zh: 只有週六，週日要回訊息。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Sam asked what the point is.
dialogue.zh: 山姆問說重點是什麼。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Tell him: the day got longer.
dialogue.zh: 告訴他：一天變長了。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: He wrote back, one word only.
dialogue.zh: 他回傳，只有一個字。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Which word, show me that.
dialogue.zh: 哪個字？給我看。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: He typed: strange, thanks.
dialogue.zh: 他打字：奇怪，謝謝。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: That is Sam's way of smiling.
dialogue.zh: 那就是山姆微笑的方式。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: My shoulders dropped today.
dialogue.zh: 我的肩膀今天鬆下來了。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: The tension left, like the signal, quietly.
dialogue.phonetic: /ðə ˈtɛnʃən lɛft, laɪk ðə ˈsɪɡnəl, ˈkwaɪətli./
dialogue.zh: 那股緊繃，像訊號一樣安靜地走了。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: The trail was not even hard.
dialogue.zh: 那條山路其實一點都不難。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: You complained twice, gently.
dialogue.zh: 你很輕柔地抱怨了兩次。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Once, about the wind, I think.
dialogue.zh: 一次，是為了那陣風，我想。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Twice, and I have the proof here.
dialogue.phonetic: /twaɪs, ænd aɪ hæv ðə pruf hɪr./
dialogue.zh: 兩次，而且我在這裡有證據。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: What did the plane do to us?
dialogue.phonetic: /wʌt dɪd ðə pleɪn du tu ʌs?/
dialogue.zh: 那個飛機模式對我們做了什麼？

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: It gave back a whole Saturday.
dialogue.zh: 它還給我們一整個週六。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Nine photos, and I drew one.
dialogue.zh: 九張照片，我還畫了一張。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: The dog? The kite? Show me now.
dialogue.phonetic: /ðə dɔːɡ? ðə kaɪt? ʃoʊ mi naʊ./
dialogue.zh: 狗？風箏？現在給我看。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Badly drawn, but it has a tail.
dialogue.phonetic: /ˈbædli drɔn, bʌt ɪt hæz ə teɪl./
dialogue.zh: 畫得爛，不過它有尾巴。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: A tail is the hard part, well done.
dialogue.phonetic: /ə teɪl ɪz ðə hɑːrd pɑːrt, wɛl dʌn./
dialogue.zh: 尾巴最難畫，你畫好了。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: The report will like this week.
dialogue.zh: 報告會喜歡這一週的數字。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Let us look Sunday, not tonight.
dialogue.zh: 週日再來看，今晚不要。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Tonight the bowl is empty.
dialogue.zh: 今晚那個碗是空的。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Empty bowl, full evening, go sit.
dialogue.zh: 空碗、滿滿的夜晚，去坐吧。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: I have one more thing from the trail.
dialogue.phonetic: /aɪ hæv wʌn mɔːr θɪŋ frʌm ðə treɪl./
dialogue.zh: 從山上我還帶回一件事。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: You found the old stone bridge.
dialogue.zh: 你找到了那座舊石橋。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: I saw it, I did not film it.
dialogue.phonetic: /aɪ sɔː ɪt, aɪ dɪd nɑt fɪlm ɪt./
dialogue.zh: 我看見了，但沒有錄影。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Then it stays yours, not the cloud.
dialogue.phonetic: /ðɛn ɪt steɪz jʊərz, nɑt ðə klaʊd./
dialogue.zh: 那它屬於你，不屬於雲端。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Sunday night, then we count?
dialogue.zh: 週日晚上，我們再算一次？

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Count, and bring the tea, it rains.
dialogue.phonetic: /kaʊnt, ænd brɪŋ ðə tiː, ɪt reɪnz./
dialogue.zh: 要算，把茶帶來，外面在下雨。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: I will ask my mother about hers.
dialogue.phonetic: /aɪ wɪl æsk maɪ ˈmʌðər əˈbaʊt hɜːrz./
dialogue.zh: 我也會問我媽她的用量。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Ask kindly, she loves that soup pot.
dialogue.phonetic: /æsk ˈkaɪndli, ʃi lʌvz ðæt sup pɑt./
dialogue.zh: 好好問她，她很愛那個湯鍋。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: She said yes, on one big rule.
dialogue.phonetic: /ʃi sɛd jɛs, ɑn wʌn bɪɡ rul./
dialogue.zh: 她答應了，只有一個大條件。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Which rule, tell me quickly.
