dialogue.zh: 什麼條件？你快說。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Phones in the bowl, but soup first.
dialogue.phonetic: /foʊnz ɪn ðə boʊl, bʌt sup fɜːrst./
dialogue.zh: 手機進碗裡，但先喝湯。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: That rule works, even in her house.
dialogue.phonetic: /ðæt rul wɜːrks, ˈivən ɪn hɜːr haʊs./
dialogue.zh: 那條規矩有用，在她家也是。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Look, the new report landed.
dialogue.zh: 你看，新的報告到了。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: And mine fell to two eleven.
dialogue.zh: 我的掉到兩小時十一分。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Two eleven! From four twelve.
dialogue.zh: 兩小時十一！之前是四小時十二。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Two hours back, every single day.
dialogue.zh: 每天找回兩個小時。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Popcorn for this, right now.
dialogue.zh: 這值得爆米花，現在就做。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Two spoons, and no salt for me.
dialogue.phonetic: /tuː spunz, ænd noʊ sɔlt fɔːr mi./
dialogue.zh: 兩勺，我那份不加鹽。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Saturday, the club walks at eight.
dialogue.zh: 星期六，散步團八點出發。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: East gate, and phones stay packed.
dialogue.zh: 東門口，手機要收進包里。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Packed means inside the bag.
dialogue.zh: 收進包就是放在包裡面。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Not in hands, not on the table.
dialogue.phonetic: /nɑt ɪn hændz, nɑt ɑn ðə ˈteɪbəl./
dialogue.zh: 不在手上，也不在桌上。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Sam brought his, for music only.
dialogue.zh: 山姆帶了，只為了聽音樂。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Music in a pocket, eyes on trees.
dialogue.phonetic: /ˈmjuzɪk ɪn ə ˈpɑkɪt, aɪz ɑn triz./
dialogue.zh: 音樂放口袋，眼睛看著樹。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Our group is eight walkers today.
dialogue.zh: 我們這一團今天有八個人。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Three left theirs at home entirely.
dialogue.zh: 有三個人整個留在家裡。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Left them? In the house? Alone?
dialogue.zh: 留在家裡？就擱在空房子裡？

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Alone and safe, the door is locked.
dialogue.phonetic: /əˈloʊn ænd seɪf, ðə dɔːr ɪz lɑkt./
dialogue.zh: 手機自己在家，門也鎖好了。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: My pocket feels light, weird.
dialogue.zh: 我的口袋很輕，好奇怪。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Light pockets, heavy morning.
dialogue.zh: 口袋輕輕的，早晨滿滿的。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Who walks first today, you or me?
dialogue.phonetic: /hu wɔːks fɜːrst təˈdeɪ, ju ɔːr mi?/
dialogue.zh: 今天誰走最前面，你還是我？

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: You, your legs are longer than mine.
dialogue.phonetic: /ju, jʊər lɛɡz ɑːr ˈlɔːŋɡər ðæn maɪn./
dialogue.zh: 你吧，你的腿比我的長。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: The river road smells like rain.
dialogue.zh: 河濱步道聞起來像要下雨。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: It rained last night, the dirt is wet.
dialogue.phonetic: /ɪt reɪnd læst naɪt, ðə dɜrt ɪz wɛt./
dialogue.zh: 昨晚下過雨，泥巴還是濕的。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Someone's bag just buzzed, loudly.
dialogue.zh: 有個人的包包剛剛很大聲地響。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Sam, of course, he forgot silent.
dialogue.zh: 當然是山姆，他忘了關聲音。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Our rule: the ring carries snacks.
dialogue.zh: 我們的規矩：響的人背點心。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: He will let his phone ring again.
dialogue.phonetic: /hi wɪl lɛt hɪz foʊn rɪŋ əˈɡɛn./
dialogue.zh: 他還會故意讓它響的。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: One mile in, nobody looked down.
dialogue.zh: 走了一英里，沒有人在低頭。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: They watched ducks, I watched them.
dialogue.zh: 他們在看鴨子，我在看他們。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: A heron, actually, a big one.
dialogue.zh: 那是一隻蒼鷺，很大隻。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Did anyone photograph that bird?
dialogue.zh: 有人拍了那隻鳥嗎？

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Nobody, we just stood there.
dialogue.zh: 沒有人拍，我們就站在那裡。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Five whole minutes, with a heron.
dialogue.zh: 整整五分鐘，就看一隻蒼鷺。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: My brain kept it, no file.
dialogue.zh: 我腦子留住了，沒有檔案。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: That photo lives behind the eyes.
dialogue.zh: 那種照片存在眼睛後面。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Café stop, ten o'clock, as planned.
dialogue.zh: 咖啡休息，十點整，照計畫。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Order for the table, no phones out.
dialogue.phonetic: /ˈɔːrdər fɔːr ðə ˈteɪbəl, noʊ foʊnz aʊt./
dialogue.zh: 幫整桌點餐，手機別拿出來。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: I remembered everybody's name.
dialogue.zh: 我記得每一個人的名字。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Two lattes, one soy, no sugar.
dialogue.zh: 兩杯拿鐵，一杯換豆奶，不加糖。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: The toast came, I did not shoot it.
dialogue.phonetic: /ðə toʊst keɪm, aɪ dɪd nɑt ʃuːt ɪt./
dialogue.zh: 吐司端來了，我沒有拍它。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: You ate it, warm, that is better.
dialogue.phonetic: /ju eɪt ɪt, wɔːrm, ðæt ɪz ˈbɛtər./
dialogue.zh: 你趁熱把它吃掉了，比較好。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Our table talked over the bread.
dialogue.zh: 我們那一桌繞著麵包聊天。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Mia's job, the rain, Sam's white bowl.
dialogue.phonetic: /ˈmiəz dʒɑb, ðə reɪn, sæmz waɪt boʊl./
dialogue.zh: 米亞的工作、下雨、山姆的白碗。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Then a man at the counter shouted.
dialogue.phonetic: /ðɛn ə mæn æt ðə ˈkaʊntər ˈʃaʊtɪd./
dialogue.zh: 接著櫃檯有個先生在喊人。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: A wallet, found beside the door.
dialogue.zh: 一個錢包，在門口旁邊撿到的。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: It had an ID, and a number.
dialogue.phonetic: /ɪt hæd ən aɪ di, ænd ə ˈnʌmbər./
dialogue.zh: 裡面有身分證，還有一組電話。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: One call on speaker, that is allowed.
dialogue.phonetic: /wʌn kɔl ɑn ˈspikər, ðæt ɪz əˈlaʊd./
dialogue.zh: 開擴音打一通，這是允許的。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: The owner's wife picked up fast.
dialogue.zh: 失主的妻子很快就接起來。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: She cried, then said thanks twice.
dialogue.zh: 她哭了，然後說了兩次謝謝。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: We handed the wallet to the shop.
dialogue.phonetic: /wi ˈhændɪd ðə ˈwɑlət tu ðə ʃɑp./
dialogue.zh: 我們把錢包交給那間店家。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: A tool, that is all a phone is.
dialogue.phonetic: /ə tuːl, ðæt ɪz ɔl ə foʊn ɪz./
dialogue.zh: 工具而已，手機就只是工具。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Eight walkers, zero photos online.
dialogue.zh: 八個人，網路上一張都沒有。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Yet Sam posted a photo at last.
dialogue.phonetic: /jɛt sæm ˈpoʊstɪd ə ˈfoʊtoʊ æt læst./
dialogue.zh: 不過山姆最後還是拍了一張。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: One, for his mother, fair enough.
dialogue.zh: 只一張，給他媽媽，很合理。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: His mother texted back nine words.
dialogue.zh: 他媽媽回了九個字過來。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Do I have messages worth checking?
dialogue.zh: 我有值得看的訊息嗎？

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Six, and only one can't wait.
dialogue.zh: 六則，只有那一則不能等。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: That one was Mia, about soup.
dialogue.zh: 那一則是米亞，講湯的事。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Tell her Sunday dinner still stands.
dialogue.zh: 告訴她週日晚餐的約還在。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Next month we visit Taichung, then.
dialogue.zh: 那下個月我們就去台中。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Take the train, it has no signal.
dialogue.phonetic: /teɪk ðə treɪn, ɪt hæz noʊ ˈsɪɡnəl./
dialogue.zh: 坐火車去吧，那段沒有訊號。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: My list of rules is long now.
dialogue.phonetic: /maɪ lɪst əv rulz ɪz lɔŋ naʊ./
dialogue.zh: 我的規矩清單現在很長了。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Read it, I will fold the map.
dialogue.phonetic: /rid ɪt, aɪ wɪl foʊld ðə mæp./
dialogue.zh: 你唸吧，我來摺地圖。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Bowl on the table at dinner.
dialogue.zh: 吃晚飯時，碗擺在桌上。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Moon on at nine, and no blue.
dialogue.phonetic: /mun ɑn æt naɪn, ænd noʊ bluː./
dialogue.zh: 九點開月亮，不看藍光。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Not two weeks, but close enough.
dialogue.zh: 還沒兩週，但也快了。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: You never once asked for it back.
dialogue.phonetic: /ju ˈnɛvər wʌns æskt fɔːr ɪt bæk./
dialogue.zh: 你連一次都沒要它回來。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Weekend caps are a little wider.
dialogue.zh: 週末的上限寬一點點。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Wider, not open, that is fair.
dialogue.zh: 寬一點，但不是沒有限度。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Gray screen at eight, every night.
dialogue.zh: 每天八點把畫面變灰。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: It made the whole app boring.
dialogue.zh: 它把整個 App 變得無聊。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Boring is working, that is funny.
dialogue.zh: 無聊居然有用，這倒好笑。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Funny how small switches feel big.
dialogue.zh: 小開關感覺很大，真妙。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Serious question: did you sleep?
dialogue.zh: 認真問：你睡得好嗎？

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Seven hours, no midnight reaching.
dialogue.zh: 七小時，半夜沒有亂摸手機。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: No reaching, that is my win too.
dialogue.phonetic: /noʊ ˈriːtʃɪŋ, ðæt ɪz maɪ wɪn tuː./
dialogue.zh: 不亂摸，那也是我的勝利。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Our win, you said we, notice that.
dialogue.phonetic: /ˈaʊər wɪn, ju sɛd wi, ˈnoʊtɪs ðæt./
dialogue.zh: 是我們贏，你剛說了我們。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Sam came to the walk again.
dialogue.zh: 山姆又來參加散步了。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: With the white bowl, in his bag.
dialogue.phonetic: /wɪt ðə waɪt boʊl, ɪn hɪz bæɡ./
dialogue.zh: 帶著那個白碗，放在包裡。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: He carries it for everyone now.
dialogue.zh: 他現在幫所有人收手機。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Five phones, one white bowl, full.
dialogue.zh: 五支手機，一個白碗，裝滿了。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Next Saturday, the whole morning.
dialogue.zh: 下週六，我們要走整個上午。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Nine to one, then noodles after.
dialogue.zh: 九點到一點，然後去吃麵。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Bring your sketch pad that day.
dialogue.zh: 那天把你的素描本帶來。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: And the good pencil, blue again?
dialogue.zh: 還有那枝好鉛筆，又是藍色？

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Blue, it matches the river road.
dialogue.zh: 藍色，它跟河濱步道很配。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: The river looked gray, honestly.
dialogue.zh: 老實說，那條河看起來是灰的。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Gray water, bright company.
dialogue.zh: 水是灰的，同行的人很亮。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: That is a line for the fridge.
dialogue.phonetic: /ðæt ɪz ə laɪn fɔːr ðə frɪdʒ./
dialogue.zh: 這句值得寫在冰箱上。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: One more number before we sleep.
dialogue.zh: 睡覺前再看一個數字。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Thirty-one unlocks today, mine.
dialogue.zh: 我今天是三十一個解鎖。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Thirty-one, from sixty-one.
dialogue.zh: 三十一，從六十一降下來的。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Half the reaching, twice the soup.
dialogue.zh: 伸手少一半，湯多了兩倍。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Write both numbers, keep the note.
dialogue.zh: 兩個數字都寫，留好這張紙。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: For the Sunday when the graph is bad.
dialogue.phonetic: /fɔːr ðə ˈsʌndeɪ wɛn ðə ɡræf ɪz bæd./
dialogue.zh: 留給曲線很難看的那個週日。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Same time next Sunday, then?
dialogue.zh: 那下個週日同一時間？

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Same time, same table, one bowl.
dialogue.zh: 同一時間、同一張桌、一個碗。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Eight o'clock, kettle ready too.
dialogue.zh: 八點整，水壺也先準備好。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Coffee first, always, no screen.
dialogue.zh: 先喝咖啡，永遠如此，不看螢幕。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Good night, put the phone down.
dialogue.zh: 晚安，把手機放下吧。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Downstairs, face down, then books.
dialogue.zh: 下樓、朝下放，然後看書。
